mapper.select: select distinct created_at::date as activity_date from user_answers where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = false and answer_status = 'REVIEWED' order by activity_date desc

select count(*) filter (where review_card.status = 'ACTIVE' and review_card.due_at <= #{now}) as due_card_count, count(*) filter ( where review_card.status = 'ACTIVE' and (review_card.due_at is null or review_card.due_at > #{now}) ) as in_progress_card_count, count(*) filter (where review_card.status = 'MASTERED') as mastered_card_count from review_cards review_card inner join user_error_types user_error_type on user_error_type.id = review_card.user_error_type_id and user_error_type.status = 'ACTIVE' and user_error_type.learning_mode = #{learningMode} where review_card.user_id = #{userId} and review_card.deleted = false
